diego.s: Quick update  Aurelia Retail signed a 1-year Dedicated renewal + completed Azure Marketplace ISV onboarding today. Huge cross-team effort. :tada:
maya.pm: Fantastic! Any topline numbers to add to the case study? latency / throughput wins?
olivia: Marketing will draft a 2-paragraph case study and 1-slide perf summary. Can someone share final perf numbers and a short customer quote?
dryan.sales: Customer quote inbound  from Aurelias Head of Platform: "Redwoods Dedicated plan allowed us to hit consistent sub-80ms p50 at peak, and batching reduced token costs by ~32%". They approved using this in collateral.
olivia: Perfect, thanks Ryan. Can you also confirm the renewal terms (committed GPUs, burst, SLA) for the blurb?
finance-bot: [auto] Renewal details: 12 months, 4x V100-equivalent GPUs reserved, 25% burst, Enterprise SLA (99.95%). Contract #AR-2026-77.
diego.s: Customer also adopted our Optimize recommendations  switched to int8 quantization for the retrieval model and added prefix KV caching. That was the main cost saver.
maya.pm: Can product/eng confirm there are no outstanding action items post-listing? Any edge connectors or support runbooks needed?
olivia: @diego.s can you and @olivia double-check? (sorry for ping loop)
diego.s: I'll triage. We need to deliver an SFTP connector and a lightweight health endpoint for their air-gapped stores. I'll open a ticket in eng-runtime and mark high priority.
olivia: Nice. We'll plan a joint webinar in Q3 and a blog post. Draft social copy: "Aurelia Retail scales inference for per-store recommendations with predictable latency using Redwood Dedicated + Azure Marketplace." Thoughts?
ryan.sales: Love it. Add a line about cost savings and the quote. Also push to partner portal.
marketplace-bot: [auto] Azure Marketplace listing: LIVE  Aurelia Retail ISV  listing id: ar-2026-210. Impressions first 12h: 56K, leads: 5.
maya.pm: I'll schedule an internal launch email for tomorrow 9am so GTM can amplify. Can we include the perf slide and the contract summary?
diego.s: Yep. Also tagging support: add runbook for renewal entitlements and burst throttle behavior.
olivia: Thanks team  shoutout to @ryan.sales for managing the customer comms and to finance for the fast PO processing. :clap:
finance-bot: [auto] PO received: PO-AR-9901. Invoicing scheduled.
